name: Active Connections
description: Show all active connections grouped by database and state.

steps.label: Connections by database + state
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT datname, state, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() GROUP BY datname, state ORDER BY datname, state;"

name: Database Sizes
description: List all databases with their sizes, largest first.

steps.label: Query pg_database_size
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS size FROM pg_database ORDER BY pg_database_size(datname) DESC;"

name: Table Sizes
description: List top 20 tables by size in a given database.

steps.label: Query pg_total_relation_size
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -d {{database}} -c "SELECT schemaname, tablename, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename)) AS size FROM pg_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) DESC LIMIT 20;"

name: Long-Running Queries
description: Find queries running longer than a given threshold.

steps.label: Find slow queries
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS duration, left(query, 120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND query_start < now() - interval '{{minutes}} minutes' ORDER BY duration DESC;"

name: Check Locks
description: Show blocked queries and the lock holders blocking them.

steps.label: Query lock contention
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT bl.pid AS blocked_pid, a.query AS blocked_query, kl.pid AS lock_holder_pid, ka.query AS lock_holder_query FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks bl JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity a ON bl.pid = a.pid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_locks kl ON kl.transactionid = bl.transactionid AND kl.pid != bl.pid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity ka ON kl.pid = ka.pid WHERE NOT bl.granted;"

name: Backup Database
description: Dump a database to /tmp as a plain SQL file with today's date in the filename.

name: Backup Database (Compressed)
description: Dump a database to /tmp as a gzip-compressed file with today's date.

steps.label: pg_dump | gzip
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres bash -c "pg_dump -d {{database}} | gzip > /tmp/{{database}}_\$(date +%d_%m_%Y).sql.gz" && echo "Saved: /tmp/{{database}}_$(date +%d_%m_%Y).sql.gz"

name: Copy Backup to Another Server
description: SCP a backup file from this server to another server's /tmp directory.

name: List Available Backups
description: Show backup files in the daily backup directory sorted by date.

steps.label: List backup files
steps.command: ls -lht {{backup_dir}} 2>/dev/null | head -30 || echo 'Directory not found or empty'

name: Terminate DB Connections
description: Kill all active connections to a specific database (required before drop).

steps.label: pg_terminate_backend
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND datname = '{{database}}';" && echo "Done — remaining:" && echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = '{{database}}';"

name: Drop Database
description: Terminate all connections then drop the database.

steps.label: Terminate connections
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND datname = '{{database}}';"

steps.label: Drop database
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS {{database}};" && echo "Dropped: {{database}}"

name: Create Database
description: Create a new database, optionally setting an owner.

steps.label: CREATE DATABASE
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE {{database}}$([ -n '{{owner}}' ] && echo ' OWNER {{owner}}' || true);" && echo "Created: {{database}}"

steps.label: Verify database exists
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '{{database}}';"

name: Restore from SQL File
description: Restore a plain .sql dump into an existing database.

steps.label: psql restore
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -d {{database}} -f {{backup_file}} && echo "Restore complete: {{database}}"

name: Restore from Compressed Backup
description: Restore a gzip-compressed .sql.gz backup into an existing database.

steps.label: gunzip | psql restore
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres bash -c "gunzip -c {{backup_file}} | psql -d {{database}}" && echo "Restore complete: {{database}}"

name: Full DB Restore
description: Complete restore workflow: terminate connections → drop → create → restore. Handles both .sql and .sql.gz backup files.

steps.label: 1 — Terminate all connections
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND datname = '{{database}}';"

steps.label: 2 — Drop database
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS {{database}};" && echo "Dropped: {{database}}"

steps.label: 3 — Create database
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE {{database}}$([ -n '{{owner}}' ] && echo ' OWNER {{owner}}' || true);" && echo "Created: {{database}}"

steps.label: 4 — Restore backup
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres bash -c "if [[ '{{backup_file}}' == *.gz ]]; then gunzip -c {{backup_file}} | psql -d {{database}} && echo 'Restore complete (gz)'; else psql -d {{database}} -f {{backup_file}} && echo 'Restore complete (sql)'; fi"

steps.label: 5 — Verify database size
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -c "SELECT datname, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS size FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '{{database}}';"

name: Vacuum Analyze
description: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on a database to reclaim space and update planner stats.

steps.label: VACUUM ANALYZE
steps.command: echo '{{sudo_password}}' | sudo -Su postgres psql -d {{database}} -c "VACUUM ANALYZE;" && echo "Done"
